hero.heading: Search. Discover. Acquire.
hero.description: Discover and acquire independent film and TV titles — with declared avails, verified rights holders, and all materials in one place. Vaizen is launching soon.

model.title: From Search to Screening in Minutes
model.subtitle: Built for professional acquisition

steps.title: Set Up Your Profile
steps.description: Register as a Distributor, Platform, Acquisition Executive, or Film Festival. Your verified identity unlocks the platform and direct access to rights holders.

steps.title: Search the Marketplace
steps.description: Filter by genre, country of production, director, cast, festival pedigree, release window, content advisory, and more. Every result is a title with declared avails.

steps.title: Review Declared Avails
steps.description: Each title lists its territory-by-territory licensing availability upfront — AVOD, SVOD, TVOD, Pay TV, Free TV. Know what's available before the first conversation.

steps.title: Request a Screener
steps.description: Contact rights holders directly through the platform. No intermediaries. No guessing who owns what. All materials — video, metadata, artwork — in one place.

steps.title: Close the Deal
steps.description: Negotiate and close licensing deals with verified counterparties. Chain of title documentation, avails confirmation, and materials delivery — all on platform.

benefits.title: Built for Professional Acquisition
benefits.subtitle: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.

items.title: Active, Verified Listings
items.description: Every title on Vaizen has been submitted by a verified rights holder with declared avails. No dead listings. No unanswered screener requests.

items.title: Advanced Search
items.description: Filter across genre, territory, production country, director, cast, festival pedigree, content advisory, and release window simultaneously.

items.title: Upfront Avails
items.description: Territory-by-territory licensing availability declared before the first conversation. AVOD, SVOD, TVOD, Pay TV, Free TV across 50+ countries.

items.title: Materials Ready
items.description: Video screeners, metadata packages, artwork, and legal documents — all uploaded by rights holders and accessible on demand. No chasing materials after interest is confirmed.

items.title: Verified Rights Holders
items.description: Every seller is identity-verified. You know who you're dealing with before you pick up the phone. Legitimate rights ownership confirmed at registration.

items.title: Always Available
items.description: Search and discover at any hour, from any time zone. The marketplace doesn't have conference hours. Acquisition doesn't stop because the market ended.

risk.title: How Acquisition Used to Work
risk.subtitle: And why it needed to change

comparisons.title: The Old Way
comparisons.description: Sales agents. Market badges. Screener links in email chains. Weeks of back-and-forth to find out if rights are even available for your territory. Expensive, slow, and closed-network.

comparisons.title: The Vaizen Way
comparisons.description: Structured marketplace with declared avails. Search by any attribute. Reach verified rights holders directly. Interest confirmed in minutes — not after three calls across time zones.

comparisons.title: The Cinando Problem
comparisons.description: Cinando and TVSL are dated, expensive, and built around closed networks. Vaizen is open, searchable, and designed for how streaming platforms actually acquire content today.

metrics.title: Search Every Dimension That Matters
metrics.subtitle: Find exactly what your platform or distribution slate needs

items.name: Genre & Format
items.description: Filter by documentary, drama, thriller, comedy, animation, and more. Feature film, TV series, miniseries, or short — every format supported.
items.insight: Find titles that fit your platform's content strategy, not just what's available

items.name: Territory & Avails
items.description: Search by licensing window — AVOD, SVOD, TVOD — within specific territories or worldwide. Declared availability means no surprises mid-negotiation.
items.insight: Know what's licensable before you make first contact

items.name: Festival Pedigree & Talent
items.description: Filter by festival (Sundance, TIFF, Cannes, Berlin, and more), director, cast, and country of production. Surface titles that carry the curatorial signal your audience expects.
items.insight: Festival pedigree is a proven acquisition shortcut for quality signal
